Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_batch_id VARCHAR2(14);
 temp_unit VARCHAR2(15);
 temp_bag_code VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_add_on_bags number;
 temp_no_of_comp number;
 temp_no_of_bags number;
 temp_no_of_discards number;
 temp_count number;
 temp_red_tube_flag VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_bleed_start_time date;
 temp_bleed_end_time date;
 temp_sep_ind number(1);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 :chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 begin
 select max(coll_date) into :coll_date
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 
 if :coll_date is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0063');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select thaw_method
 into :thaw_method
 from cryo_units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 coll_date = trunc(:coll_date);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0186');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('1');
 handle_error;
 check_package_Failure;
 end;

 if :thaw_method is null
 then
 --
 -- note that we don't check for presence of an
 -- additional bag because the CRYO stays in the same
 -- bag as the Destined CRYO bag
 --
 begin
 -- to check if the bag code
 select substr(bag_code,2,1) , nvl(add_on_bags,0),
 bleed_start_time, bleed_end_time,
 first_sep_weight, second_sep_weight,
 first_sep_time, second_sep_time
 into temp_bag_code, temp_add_on_bags,
 temp_bleed_start_time, temp_bleed_end_time,
 :GLOBAL.first_sep_weight,
 :GLOBAL.second_sep_weight,
 :GLOBAL.first_sep_time, :GLOBAL.second_sep_time
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 if (temp_bleed_start_time is null or
 temp_bleed_end_time is null)
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0065');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 default_value('','GLOBAL.bag_code');
 reconcile_bags(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,:ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,temp_count,
 :GLOBAL.bag_code);
 check_package_failure;
 if :GLOBAL.bag_code is null
 then
 GO_ITEM('s_unit_id');
 CLEAR_ITEM;
 show_error('0039');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 :GLOBAL.second_sep := 'N';
 :GLOBAL.third_sep := 'N';
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from units
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 second_sep_time is not null;
 :GLOBAL.third_sep := 'Y';
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :GLOBAL.second_sep := 'Y';
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in checking for platelets');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('6');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 show_error('0213');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

Item.Name: OLD_PRODUCT_CODE
Item.Hint: Enter value for product code to be converted or use [LISTVAL]

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 v_local_time date;
v_sysdate date;
begin
 -- time zone change --5/16/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 --
 -- A component already pooled or relabeled cannot
 -- be converted simply because it does not exist
 -- anymore
 --
 select distinct a.product_code, product_desc,
 bag_id, product_type
 into :old_product_code, :s_old_desc,
 :GLOBAL.old_bag_id, :old_product_type
 from components a, valid_products b
 where a.unit_id = :unit_id and
 a.chapter_id = :chapter_id and
 trunc(a.coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 a.product_code = :old_product_code and
 a.component_status = 'L' and
 a.reject_reason_code is null and
 b.product_type = 'DUFFP' and
 a.product_code = b.product_code and
 v_sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_old_desc := '';
 show_error('1205');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 CHECK_INTRANSIT_INTERDICTION (:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.old_product_code,
 null,
 :GLOBAL.warehouse,
 'INTR');
 begin
 -- Split components cannot be converted
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from components
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 chapter_id = :chapter_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 product_code = :old_product_code;
 if temp_count > 1
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_product_code := :new_product_code;
 show_error('0157');
 check_package_Failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
end;

Item.Name: NEW_PRODUCT_CODE
Item.Hint: Enter value for the new product code or use [LISTVAL]

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_set_id number;
 temp_count number;
 temp_valid_set VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_valid_prod VARCHAR2(1);
 cursor c1 is
 select set_id from product_matrix
 where product_type = :new_product_type
 and bag_code = :GLOBAL.bag_code;
 cursor c2 is
 select distinct product_code
 from components
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code != 'NONE' and
 product_code != :old_product_code and
 relabel_product_code is null;
 -- pooled components are inclusive
 -- relabeled components are not considered
 -- in the search for an optimal
 -- combination
 v_local_time date;
v_sysdate date;
begin
 -- time zone change --5/16/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 select product_code, product_desc, product_type
 into :new_product_code, :s_new_desc, :new_product_type
 from valid_products
 where product_code = :new_product_code and
 product_type = 'CRYO' and
 v_sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_new_desc := '';
 show_error('1205');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from valid_product_conv
 where target_product_code = :new_product_code and
 source_product_code = :old_product_code and
 v_sysdate between eff_date and
 nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_new_desc := '';
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_product_code := :new_product_code;
 show_error('0149');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 begin
 select count(*)
 into temp_count
 from components
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = :new_product_code;
 -- relabeled and pooled components are
 -- considered as components made from the unit
 if temp_count != 0
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_product_code := :new_product_code;
 show_error('0159');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 IF :old_product_type != :new_product_type THEN
 begin
 temp_valid_set := 'N';
 for temp_set in c1 loop
 temp_valid_set := 'N';
 temp_valid_prod := 'Y';
 for temp_prod in c2 loop
 begin
 select 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from product_matrix
 where set_id=temp_set.set_id
 and product_type =
 (SELECT product_type 
 FROM valid_products
 WHERE product_code = temp_prod.product_code
 AND v_sysdate between eff_date 
 and nvl(term_date, to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')));
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 temp_valid_prod := 'N';
 exit;
 when OTHERS
 then
 -- message('Too many rows');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end loop;
 if temp_valid_prod = 'Y'
 then
 -- message('Valid Set: '||to_char(temp_set.set_id));
 temp_valid_set := 'Y';
 exit;
 else
 temp_valid_set := 'N';
 end if;
 end loop;
 if temp_valid_set != 'Y'
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_product_code := :new_product_code;
 show_error('0137');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end;
 END IF;
end;

Item.Name: SEP_DATS
Item.Hint: Enter the time of CRYO separation [MM-DD-YY HH:MI]

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_bleed_end_time date;
 v_gmt_time date;
 
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_Failure;

--MS
 if :sep_dats is not null then
 --MS Converting Local time to GMT.
 if :global.is_time_enabled = 'Y' then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id, :sep_dats, v_gmt_time); 
 :global.sep_dats := to_char(v_gmt_time, 'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');
 else
 :global.sep_dats := to_char(:sep_dats, 'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');
 end if;
 end if;
--


 --MS if :sep_dats >= sysdate
 if to_date(:global.sep_dats, 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI') >= sysdate --MS
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date;
 show_error('0103');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 
 if :GLOBAL.second_sep = 'Y'
 then
 --MS if :sep_dats <= to_rrdate(:GLOBAL.first_sep_time,'DD-MON-RR')
 if to_date(:global.sep_dats, 'MM-DD-RR') <= to_rrdate(:GLOBAL.first_sep_time,'DD-MON-RR') --MS
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 show_error('3001');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 else
 if :GLOBAL.third_sep = 'Y'
 then
 --MS if :sep_dats <= to_rrdate(:GLOBAL.second_sep_time,'DD-MON-RR')
 if to_date(:global.sep_dats, 'MM-DD-RR') <= to_rrdate(:GLOBAL.second_sep_time,'DD-MON-RR') --MS
 then
 :GLOBAL.user_err_unit_id := :unit_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_chapter_id := :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 :GLOBAL.user_err_coll_date := :coll_date;
 show_error('3002');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 exception
 when VALUE_ERROR
 then
 check_package_failure;
end;

declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if :Global.Error_count ='N' then 
 :Global.Error_count:='Y';
 if error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0) then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) then -- invalid time
 show_error('5016');
 end if;
 else
 null;
 end if; 
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NEXT-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 current_dats date;
begin
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 :system.message_level := 5;
 savepoint all_clear;
 --
 -- separation logic taken from CPISEP
 --
 begin

 --MS current_dats := :sep_dats;
 current_dats := to_date(:global.sep_dats, 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI'); --MS

 if :GLOBAL.second_sep = 'Y'
 then
 update units
 set second_sep_centrifuge_id = :centrifuge_id,
 second_sep_time = current_dats,
 second_sep_entry_mode = 'M',
 second_sep_user_id = :banner.user_id,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 end if;
 if :GLOBAL.third_sep = 'Y'
 then
 update units
 set third_sep_centrifuge_id = :centrifuge_id,
 third_sep_time = current_dats,
 third_sep_entry_mode = 'M',
 third_sep_user_id = :banner.user_id,
 program_id = :banner.prog_name
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating separation details');
 handle_error;
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
 begin
 update cryo_units
 set dummy_product_code = :old_product_code,
 actual_product_code = :new_product_code,
 thaw_method = :thaw_method,
 thaw_temperature = :thaw_temperature,
 sep_ind = to_number(
 decode(:GLOBAL.second_sep,'Y','2',
 'N','3'))
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 message('Error in updating cryo_units');
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 insert_component (:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.new_product_code,
 :ctrl_blk_1.bag_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.old_product_code,
 'MODIFY',
 null);
 check_package_failure;
 if :GLOBAL.cryo_temp_interdiction = 'Y'
 then
 message('Msg:Component has CRTE interdiction.');
 :GLOBAL.return_val := sbclib.comp_system_interdiction(
 :unit_id, :coll_date ,
 :GLOBAL.chapter_id,
 :new_product_code,
 'CRTE',:banner.user_id,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if :GLOBAL.return_val != '0'
 then
 message('Interdiction CRTE not assigned to component');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 begin
 --
 -- This SQL updates the bag info if the bag was
 -- sterile docked
 --
 update unit_add_on_bags
 set product_code = :new_product_code
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = :old_product_code and
 sdc_ws_number =
 (select sdc_ws_number
 from unit_add_on_bags
 where unit_id = :unit_id and
 trunc(coll_date) = trunc(:coll_date) and
 chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id and
 product_code = :old_product_code and
 nvl(number_of_bags,0)-nvl(bags_used,0)>0
 and rownum < 2);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 commit;

 :system.message_level := 0;
 if form_failure
 then
 clear_form(full_rollback);
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 show_error('0230');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 show_error('8010');
 check_package_failure;
 down;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_status varchar2(10);
begin
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;
 select status into temp_status
 from equipment
 where chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id
 and equip_id = :centrifuge_id
 and equip_type = 'CENT'
 and sysdate between first_production_date
 and nvl(last_production_date, sysdate);
 if nvl(temp_status,'X') != 'IN'
 then
 temp_status := sbclib.unit_system_interdiction(:ctrl_blk_1.unit_id,
 :ctrl_blk_1.coll_date,
 :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id,
 'CENT',
 LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,
 :banner.prog_name);
 if nvl(temp_status,'x') != '0'
 then
 message('Centrifuge interdiction not assigned to unit.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :s_centrifuge_id := '';
 :centrifuge_id := '';
 GO_ITEM('s_centrifuge_id');
 show_error('1142');
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_NEW_PRODUCT_LOV2

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_OLD_PRODUCT_LOV1
